# CivicPulse — Design Notes

Source: ColorLib Politics (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/politics/)
Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/politics/
New name: civicpulse

## Structure Order

1. Navbar (sticky, nav links)
2. Banner/Hero (heading, subheading, CTA, countdown)
3. Services (3 cards)
4. About (text + 2 features)
5. Gallery (image grid)
6. Counter (4 statistics)
7. Testimonials (carousel)
8. Blog (3 cards)
9. Footer (links, newsletter, Instagram, copyright)

## Section-by-Section Fidelity Notes

### Navbar
- Fixed top navigation
- Logo on left, nav links on right
- Links: Home, Service, About, Gallery, Blog, Contact
- Anchor scroll to sections

### Banner/Hero
- Full-width banner with background image
- "Don't look further, This is our Leader" main heading
- "Support Our Party" subheading
- Description paragraph
- "Get Started" CTA button
- Countdown timer below (election countdown)

### Services
- "What we Offer to our Supporters" heading
- 3 service cards in a row (responsive grid)
- Each card: icon, title, description
- Services: Conduct Campaign, Generate Member, Energy Saving Policy

### About
- "Who we are to Serve the nation" heading
- Description paragraph on left
- 2 feature items on right: Expert Services, Great Support
- Each feature: icon + title + description

### Gallery
- "Our Gallery Archive" heading
- Image grid (responsive, 3-column desktop)
- Portfolio items with images

### Counter
- 4 statistics in a row
- Animated counters on scroll
- Stats: 2K+ Projects, 5.5K Employees, 959 Clients, 367 Tickets

### Testimonials
- "Goals to Achieve for the leadership" heading
- Carousel with testimonial quotes
- Author name and role below each quote

### Blog
- "Latest From Our Blog" heading
- 3 blog cards in a row
- Each card: image, date, category tag, title, excerpt, likes/comments count

### Footer
- Multi-column layout
- Top Products links
- Newsletter subscription form
- Instagram feed section
- Copyright notice
- "Made with Component Dock" branding

## Design Token Summary

- Primary blue: #3898f8
- Body font: Poppins (sans-serif)
- Button style: sharp edges (border-radius: 0)
- Page background: #f9f9ff (off-white)
- Footer background: #222222 (dark)
